boundary_ack: Tiers are ops guidance only. No auto-publish. PUBLIC_FACING v1.7 applies to all external copy.

tier_0.label: 월 $0 (API 최소)
tier_0.cursor: Pro 1 seat; marketplace free plugins only (Figma, Exa as needed)
tier_0.gemini: OFF for weekly bundle; MKM_MARKETING_GEMINI_ALLOWED unset or 0

tier_15.label: 월 ~$15 (선별 API)
tier_15.cursor: tier_0 + Exa queries for research (cite only)
tier_15.weekly_routine: Same bundle; at most 1-2 posts/month with -Gemini on high-priority queue items (allow_gemini: true)
tier_15.publish: Optional Buffer free tier after human approval

tier_50.label: 월 ~$50 (이벤트·캠페인)
tier_50.cursor: tier_15 + AgentKits skills-only (copy/SEO checklists, no auto-send)
tier_50.weekly_routine: Event week: -Gemini + WithChart for 1 LinkedIn post; IR/deck via Figma
tier_50.gemini: Batch image + tone pass for launch week only
tier_50.publish: Buffer/Later paid tier if volume warrants
avoid: LinkedIn Ads without ads-linkedin skill review

phase2_publish_handoff.boundary: copy_guard PASS + human_approved required before Buffer or LinkedIn fire. MKM never auto-posts.
